Wave 1 discharges the four standing precision carry-forwards inherited from the S103 working papers. Source carry-forwards: CF-S104-W2-VIIAM-L11-ANCHOR (`session-103-w2-workingpaper.md §CF`), CF-S104-W3-SWMAX-MPMATH-EDGE (`session-103-w3-workingpaper.md §CF`), CF-S104-W5-BRANCH-IV-DIRECT-L1314 (`session-103-w5-workingpaper.md §CF`), CF-S104-HK-1 (`session-103-w2-workingpaper.md §CF` + housekeeping §B).         verdict    = sign(Δ)

    Simplify (the float64 shadow, for orientation only — the ≥300-bit value is the arbiter):
        |β_W|^2 ≈ 2.118e-06 ; 2|β_W|^2 ≈ 4.236e-06 ; 2|α_W||β_W| ≈ 2.910856e-03
        S_W_max − 1 ≈ 4.236e-06 + 2.910856e-03 = 2.9150926342e-03   [matches frozen envelope_upper_dev, resid 7.6e-17]
        deviation   ≈ 2.915087e-03
        Δ(float64)  ≈ 2.915087e-03 − 2.9150926342e-03 = −5.211e-09   (rel separation 1.79e-06, at the 5.7th sig fig)

    Canonical form: Δ = deviation − (2|β_W|^2 + 2|α_W||β_W|), sign determined at ≥300-bit.

    Direction (pre-registered trichotomy — the gate emits the COMPUTED sign, this is the predicted branch):
        Δ < 0  (sign −1) ⇒ deviation strictly INSIDE the upper edge ⇒ PASS (S79 sufficiency holds with strict margin).
        Δ = 0  (sign 0)  ⇒ deviation EXACTLY saturates the upper edge ⇒ structural-identity finding (the deviation IS
                            the upper endpoint by an exact algebraic identity, not a coincidence). This is NOT a FAIL.
        Δ > 0  (sign +1) ⇒ deviation BREACHES the upper edge ⇒ re-opens the S79 sufficiency question (FAIL-reopen).
        The float64 shadow (Δ ≈ −5.21e-09) POINTS toward sign −1, but float64 cannot distinguish −5e-9 from a
        rounding artifact of an exact 0; ≥300-bit is required to decide strict-interior vs exact-saturation. The gate
        does NOT pre-judge between the −1 and 0 branches — it reports the ≥300-bit sign.
    Conclusion: predicted PASS (sign −1) per the float64 lean, but the gate's job is the ≥300-bit adjudication;
        the sign it emits IS the verdict, mapped to the three pre-registered registry states.

PASS_meaning: "The §VII.BS clause-(b) bundle-exhaustiveness characterization is upgraded 'standing premise (Open Q6)' → 'result' in the annotation surface, the frozen Stage-0 blockquote span SHA == e669ccd2 (len 2514) is UNCHANGED, the theorem grade is UNCHANGED (STAGE-3-PERMANENT), and both preconditions (2c27b197 + ac1dbb28) are verified PASS. The registry prose now equals its register status (the rank-1 certificate PROVES the augmented-bundle exhaustiveness; Open Q6's augmented-bundle leg is closed-as-result). Capstone-hygiene F-consistency maintained (prose tag == register tag)."
FAIL_meaning: "verify_section_matches == False (the upgraded wording did not land, or the write/re-read mismatched — slot drift / text corruption), OR the frozen Stage-0 blockquote span SHA != e669ccd2 (the byte-immune block was touched — a HARD violation), OR a precondition is not PASS in the s103 verdict file (the upgrade is not licensed). On any of these the patch is reverted to the pre-patch byte-state and the gate closes FAIL with remediation (honest disclosure per v3-closure-recovery.md Class-1 boundary — a script-bug FAIL is byte-restored to prior state, then fixed + re-run, NOT convention-shopped)."
INFO_meaning: "Used only if exactly ONE precondition is PASS and the other is absent/INFO/FAIL at dispatch (the upgrade is partially licensed) → the gate documents which precondition is missing and defers the wording upgrade to S105 (PRE-REG-INC per mechanical-closure-discipline.md), without touching the frozen block. NOT expected (both preconditions are confirmed PASS at plan-freeze)."
